text:
emily: Quick follow-up from today's runtime roadmap segment. Need a tight set of answers we can paste into the notes and share with PM/docs. 3 short asks: 1) sprint windows for sparse-attn vs quantized-kernels, 2) Hosted default KV eviction policy, 3) recommended "safe" batching defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated (batch_ms, max_batch_tokens, prewarm). Keep replies short. @sam @raj @kevin
sam: Sparse-attn is in this sprint behind a gating test (aiming for canary next week). Quantized-kernels planned for sprint+1 (planning this week). Hosted KV eviction default = LRU; TTL only when tenant opts in.
raj: Hosted: batch_ms=10, max_batch_tokens=4096 (good p95/p99 tradeoff for chat). Dedicated with prewarm: batch_ms=25, max_batch_tokens=8192. Long contexts (>6k) benefit most from sparse-attn so quant is higher priority for 2k-4k models first.
kevin: Ops note: p99s still spike from cold-starts and oversized requests. I added a trace attr `cold_start` so SRE can filter. Also playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kernel-release (see rollback + canary gating).
maria: PM ask: we need a tiny CSV with p50/p95/p99 and rough cost delta per batch_ms bucket so sales has numbers. Can infra share?
dina: I'll open DOC ticket to publish defaults + example config. Can infra drop a copy-ready snippet?
jordan: I'll run a quick smoke matrix on the 2k/4k family against kernel-11 and share numbers. ETA Tue morning.
sam: Copy-ready example for docs (drop-in):
```
runtime_defaults:
  batching:
    batch_ms: 10
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    adaptive: true  # runtime may lower batch_ms under tail-latency pressure
  kv_cache:
    policy: LRU
    ttl_seconds: 0  # tenant override >0 enables TTL-first eviction
  prewarm:
    enabled: false
    window_ms: 1000
```
lisa: (noted) I'll collate the perf CSV with cost deltas. ETA Wed COB. :thumbsup:
emily: Please also confirm owners + ETA for the all-hands notes bullet: kernel timing (Sam - EOD), KV default (Sam - EOD), batching defaults & CSV (Lisa/Jordan - Wed), Dedicated sizing guidance (Raj - Thu).
sam: I'll post the 2-line summary in this thread by EOD.
raj: Will draft Dedicated sizing guidance after CSV.
kevin: CI perf tests will gate the canary; I'll ensure they're green before rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy-notify: planned canary rollout kernel-v11 on 2026-03-29T02:00:00Z (window 2h).
dina: Filing task DOC-8342 to track docs + PM table.
maria: Great, this gives Sales something to work with. If anyone wants to opt-out of follow-ups, say so here.
emily: Thanks all 44d I'll compile notes and post to #all-hands-notes.
